interpretation.control_region_boundary: bounded: drive A has zero local speed-matched cruise control grid points (its cruise interval 2 starts exactly at the Class-L rise and ends 0.56 s after the fall; interval 1 lies outside the analysis window), so in-drive Class-L specificity is tested on drive B only; drive A contributes the reproduction requirement, not the specificity control.
interpretation.exhaustive_negative: observed/deterministic: 2929 candidate fields are fine-swept in both drives and exactly 0 reproduce as LEADING the EPS motor-feedback proxy (|r| >= 0.4 in both drives, peak lag >= +50 ms in both). Per-drive fine-stage lead context: {"drive_a": {"fine_motor_abs_r_ge_0.40": 246, "of_those_leading_ge_50ms": 69}, "drive_b": {"fine_motor_abs_r_ge_0.40": 48, "of_those_leading_ge_50ms": 0}}. No bus1 field in these captures behaves like a lateral target/planner input for the EPS. The strongest reproduced lagging family is a steering-angle echo: 0x160[22]s16be tracks 0x025 angle at r=0.9963(-75 ms) and r=0.8698(-100 ms), so bus1 demonstrably carries delayed steering feedback, not commands.
interpretation.lag_range_boundary: bounded: the declared tested lead range is +/-500 ms at 25 ms resolution. Several weak reproduced correlates peak at the +/-500 ms boundary, i.e. slow window-scale trends rather than causal control-path leads; a Toyota lateral command consumed by a 100 Hz EPS is not expected to lead by more than a few control frames, well inside the tested range.
interpretation.lagging_classification: observed/deterministic: 26 reproduced fields lag the motor proxy (peak lag <= -50 ms in both drives), all feedback-like; the drive-B speed-matched cruise control region shows the strongest of them are equally present outside Class-L, i.e. generic steering/torque echoes, not Class-L-gated commands.

method.control: cruise latch, non-Class-L, >2 s edge guard, wheel speed within Class-L range

filters.checksum: last/second-to-last byte nontrivial head-sum/XOR carrier at >= 0.9 (byte and overlap suppression; zero tail is not self-evidence)
filters.counter: dominant successive delta mod 256 in 1..15 at >= 0.9 (byte and overlap suppression)
filters.diversity: scalar >= 8 distinct window values; nibble/delta >= 4; bit minority >= 0.02

method.lag_convention: r(tau)=corr(field(t),target(t+tau)); tau>0 means field LEADS target
